description: Video Game Giveaways at the palm of your hand, uses the Gamepower Api to gather giveaways from various web stores
readme:
Frapp.


This Website Provides the latest video game giveaways from sources such as the Epic games Store, IndieGala,Steam Gog,Alienware Arena and many More
The Website Uses the GamePower Api Which can be found here: https://www.gamerpower.com/api-read

To make a similar project you can fork or clone the project using 
git clone https://github.com/gamerfunky78/FRAPP-GIVEAWAYS.git
